description: Filter KORKİMYA polyethylene (PE) and polypropylene (PP) grades by polymer type, processing method (extrusion, injection moulding, blow moulding) and melt flow index range (g/10 min). Returns matching grades with melt flow index, density, processing methods and product page URL; grades whose specification does not state a filtered property are returned as 'unstated'.

mfiMax.description: Optional maximum melt flow index, g/10 min.

mfiMin.description: Optional minimum melt flow index, g/10 min.

processing.description: Optional processing method: Ekstrüzyon, Enjeksiyon kalıplama, Üfleme kalıplama (English: extrusion, injection moulding, blow moulding).

name: polymer_grade_selector
title: PE / PP grade selector
